newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Foreign investment in Colombia off in February.
newsitem.headline: Foreign investment in Colombia off in February.

text.p: Direct foreign investment in Colombia fell by 6.6 percent in February compared to the same month last year, the country's foreign investment board said.
The board, known as Coinvertir, said direct foreign investment in January and February was up 95.6 percent over the first two of 1996, however, thanks to a huge boost in investment flows in January.
In February, new direct foreign investment -- excluding the volatile oil sector -- totaled $135.7 million compared to $145.2 million in the same month last year, according to Coinvertir.
For January-February the total stood at $312.28, however.
The United States was the leading source of foreign investment in February, accounting for 63 percent of the total or $85 million, Coinvertir said.
It said investment by Britain shrank by $14 million in February compared to the same month last year.
